If $\overset{→}{S}$ be a unit vector, then the magnitude of the vector $\left(\overset{→}{a} ⋅ \overset{→}{S}\right)\left(\overset{→}{b} \times \overset{→}{c}\right)$+ $\left(\overset{→}{b} ⋅ \overset{→}{S}\right) \left(\overset{→}{c} \times \overset{→}{a}\right)$+   $\left(\overset{→}{c}$⋅ \overset{→}{S}\right)$\left(\overset{→}{a} \times \overset{→}{b}\right)$ is equal to
questions.solution:
Let $\overset{\to}{r} = \left(\overset{\to}{a} ⋅ \overset{\to}{S}\right)\left(\overset{\to}{b} \times \overset{\to}{c}\right) + \left(\overset{\to}{b} ⋅ \overset{\to}{S}\right)\left(\overset{\to}{c} \times \overset{\to}{a}\right) + \left(\overset{\to}{c} ⋅ \overset{\to}{S}\right)\left(\overset{\to}{a} \times \overset{\to}{b}\right)$
$\overset{\to}{S}$ can be written as a linear combination of $\overset{\to}{b} \times \overset{\to}{c}, \overset{\to}{c} \times \overset{\to}{a}, \overset{\to}{a} \times \overset{\to}{b}$
$\overset{\to}{S} = x\left(\overset{\to}{b} \times \overset{\to}{c}\right) + y\left(\overset{\to}{c} \times \overset{\to}{a}\right) + z\left(\overset{\to}{a} \times \overset{\to}{b}\right)$
Taking dot with $\overset{\to}{a}$
$\overset{\to}{S} ⋅ \overset{\to}{a} = x\left[\overset{\to}{a}\overset{\to}{b}\overset{\to}{c}\right] ⇒ x = \dfrac{\overset{\to}{S} \cdot \overset{\to}{a}}{[ \overset{\to}{a}\overset{\to}{b}\overset{\to}{c} ]}$
Taking dot with $\overset{\to}{b}$
$\overset{\to}{S} ⋅ \overset{\to}{b} = y\left[\overset{\to}{a}\overset{\to}{b}\overset{\to}{c}\right] ⇒ x = \dfrac{\overset{\to}{S} \cdot \overset{\to}{b}}{[ \overset{\to}{a}\overset{\to}{b}\overset{\to}{c} ]}$
Similarly $z = \dfrac{\overset{\to}{S} \cdot \overset{\to}{c}}{\left[\overset{\to}{a}\overset{\to}{b}\overset{\to}{c}\right]}$
Hence $\overset{\to}{S} = \dfrac{\left(\overset{\to}{S} ⋅ \overset{\to}{a}\right)\left(\overset{\to}{b} \times \overset{\to}{c}\right) + \left(\overset{\to}{S} ⋅ \overset{\to}{b}\right)\left(\overset{\to}{c} \times \overset{\to}{a}\right) + \left(\overset{\to}{S} ⋅ \overset{\to}{c}\right)\left(\overset{\to}{a} \times \overset{\to}{b}\right)}{\left[\overset{\to}{a}\overset{\to}{b}\overset{\to}{c}\right]}$
$⇒ \overset{\to}{r} = \overset{\to}{S}\left[\overset{\to}{a}\overset{\to}{b}\overset{\to}{c}\right]$

$⇒ \left|\overset{\to}{r}\right| = \left|\overset{\to}{S}\right|\left|\left[\overset{\to}{a}\overset{\to}{b}\overset{\to}{c}\right]\right|$
$= 1\left|\left|\begin{cases}1 & 1 & 1 \\ 1 & 4 & - 1 \\ 1 & 1 & 2\end{cases}\right|\right|$
$= \left|1\left(9\right) - 1\left(3\right) + 1\left(- 3\right)\right|$
$= 3$

questions.solution:
$\left[\overset{→}{V1}\overset{→}{V2}\overset{→}{V3}\right] =\left|\begin{cases}1 & a & 1 \\ 0 & 1 & a \\ a & 0 & 1\end{cases}\right| = a^{3} - a + 1 = f\left(a\right)$ (say)

So, for minima
$f^{'} \left(a\right) =3a^{2} - 1 = 0$

questions.solution:
Let the points A, B$ be \left(\alpha, {\alpha}^{2}\right), \left(\beta, {\beta}^{2}\right)respectively where \alpha$> 0, \beta$< 0$
\overset{→}{OA} = \alpha\overset{^}{i} + {\alpha}^{2}\overset{^}{j}$
$\overset{→}{OB} = \beta\overset{^}{i} + {\beta}^{2}\overset{^}{j}$
$\overset{→}{OA} ⋅ \overset{^}{i} = \alpha = 1 ⇒ \overset{→}{OA} = \overset{^}{i} + \overset{^}{j}$
$\overset{→}{OB} ⋅ \overset{^}{j} = {\beta}^{2} = 4 ⇒ \beta = \pm 2$
$∵ \beta < 0 ⇒ \beta = - 2 ⇒ \overset{→}{OB} = - 2\overset{^}{i} + 4\overset{^}{j}$
$\overset{→}{OA} ⋅ \overset{→}{OB} = $\left(\overset{^}{i} + \overset{^}{j}\right) \left(- 2\overset{^}{i} + 4\overset{^}{j}\right)$ = - 2 + 4 = 2

questions.q: For three vectors $\overset{\to}{a}, \overset{\to}{b}$ and $\overset{\to}{c}$, if $| \overset{\to}{a} | = 2, | \overset{\to}{b} | = 1, \overset{\to}{a} \times \overset{\to}{b} = \overset{\to}{c}$ and $\overset{\to}{b} \times \overset{\to}{c} = \overset{\to}{a}$, then the value of $\left[\overset{\to}{a} + \overset{\to}{b}\overset{\to}{b} + \overset{\to}{c}\overset{\to}{c} + \overset{\to}{a}\right]$ is equal to
questions.solution:
We know that, $\left[\overset{\to}{a} + \overset{\to}{b}\overset{\to}{b} + \overset{\to}{c}\overset{\to}{c} + \overset{\to}{a}\right] = 2 [ \overset{\to}{a}\overset{\to}{b}\overset{\to}{c} ]$
Given $\overset{\to}{b} \times \overset{\to}{c} = \overset{\to}{a}$
Taking dot product with $\overset{\to}{a}$, we get,
$\left[\overset{\to}{a}\overset{\to}{b}\overset{\to}{c}\right] = \overset{\to}{a} . \overset{\to}{a} = {\left|\overset{\to}{a}\right|}^{2} = 4$

Hence, $\left[\overset{\to}{a} + \overset{\to}{b}\overset{\to}{b} + \overset{\to}{c}\overset{\to}{c} + \overset{\to}{a}\right] = 2 \times 4 = 8$
